item.title: HSFO rebounds, prompt offers cap gains
item.description: Asia’s high sulphur fuel oil (HSFO) market recovered slightly on Tuesday amid stronger bids, though competitive prompt offers limited gains. item.title: LR and Latsco chart a new digital course for ship classification
item.description: Lloyd’s Register (LR) and Latsco have successfully completed a proof-of-concept for a new standard in digital class assurance with data-driven surveys. This collaboration aims to demonstrate how verified operational vessel data can fully meet class survey requirements, without compromising safety, integrity, or technical rigour.
